<b>Fleatopia Supplies</b> is a [[Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, acquired from [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]].
__NOTOC__

== Delivery Item ==
[[File:Courier's_Swag.png|link=Courier's Swag|left|thumb|100x100px]]
The [[Courier's Swag]] has a total of 5 hit points. It takes 1 damage for every Mask of damage Hornet takes, and also when Hornet makes a heavy landing, hits a ceiling while using [[Silk Soar]], or runs into a wall while using [[Swift Step]]. Travelling with the [[Bellways]], [[Ventrica]], [[Flea Caravan]] or using the [[Beastling Call]] immediately destroys it.
{{Clear}}

== Wish ==
[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is given a Courier's Swag by Tipp & Pill to carefully deliver to [[Fleamaster Mooshka]] in [[Fleatopia]].

This Delivery can be repeated an infinite amount of times, allowing for a steady source of [[Rosaries]]. However, Tipp & Pill will only offer 2 Deliveries at a time. The most recently completed Delivery will never appear twice in a row. In addition, only the first completion of a Delivery contributes towards <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i>.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Tipp & Pill 01.png!Tipp & Pill location in Bellhart
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Flea Caravan 04.png!Fleamaster Mooshka location in Fleatopia
}}

== Possible routes ==
===Memorium route===
This route goes through the [[Blasted Steps]] and the [[Choral Chambers]] to arrive at the [[Memorium]]. From there it goes through the [[Putrified Ducts]] to end up at Fleatopia.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Fleatopia Supplies 01.png!Memorium route
}}
=== Bilewater route ===
This route goes through [[Greymoor]], [[Sinner's Road]] and the [[Exhaust Organ]] to arrive at [[Bilewater]]. From there it goes up to the Putrified Ducts to end up at Fleatopia.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Fleatopia Supplies 02.png!Bilewater route
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Rosaries large.png|link=Rosaries|left|thumb|100x100px]]

By turning in the supplies to Fleamaster Mooshka, he rewards Hornet with {{R|410}} in [[Act 2]], and {{R|480}} in [[Act 3]].

{{Clear}}
